notes.title: Update: Flower Stand and Save Backup System 💐💾
notes.content:
💐 Flower Stand
With the new flower stand, you can sell flowers you've either grown yourself or bought from the shop. Visitors coming to the cemetery can purchase flowers from the stand and place them on the grave they are visiting. This allows you to both provide a service and earn income.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468522/688b646c8719cd6c767d9c786eacfc84c4f48004.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468522/445833bb1e39da3f2960b5e800f3c0d0b18b6fb5.png"]
💾 New Game Save Backup System
Sometimes Steam Cloud may fail to save your files due to user error, internet issues, or antivirus software deleting them. To prevent this, we've developed a new system that backs up your saves in multiple locations. Even if the original file is deleted, it will be automatically restored from the backup.


‼️The automatic save recovery system introduced in this version can only recover save files lost after this version. If the system failed to recover these files, you can manually check the save files located in the The Unholy Priest_Data folder, inside the BackupSaves directory in the game installation path.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468522/73e00250eba895c090e4c0d66069cc141eae45a0.png"] 
❗Please note: This system is designed to recover only files lost after this version. Unfortunately, we are unable to recover files lost in earlier versions.


If you need further assistance
Discord server: 
https://discord.gg/bsQFhKWyww

notes.title: Update: New Grave Customization Options
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

We're back with an update that includes some highly requested features.
(A fantastic new exorcism ritual is coming in our next update!)

You can now directly cover up graves that were partially dug, dug in the wrong spot, or belong to escaped dead by picking up a shovel and holding down the "C" key using the new option that appears.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468522/a08696095cfe35473a2b92b7bc787d89264da08f.png

The outline effect that appears when interacting with weeds has been made red and thicker for better visibility.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468522/d0d5e6cbe58818a2a482931350a8c27245ed76c9.png

You can delete old graves using the Clear Grave option located at the top right of the Grave Detail window. However, doing this means you will no longer earn daily income from that grave.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468522/b1004460d107b552842bf533fefef6c82b234180.png

The cleanliness and watering level of a grave has been added to the Grave Detail window.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468522/6738131446743853c9828ceaf98f8a542ec2a0ce.png

After placing a gravestone, you can rotate it by holding down the "R" key on your keyboard.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468522/04eb76d73e0b1d1562a205e798c2a4324263dd4d.png

notes.title: Update: New Feature, Bug Fixes, Optimizations
notes.content:
Hello there!

Here are the new features, optimizations, and fixes:

New Feature – The Cursed Hours:
Between 1 AM and 3 AM, the map will be covered with intense fog, and monsters will spawn at random times to try to kill you.
You can kill them using a small crucifix (press the "T" key).
If you are sleeping or performing an exorcism ritual, they won’t attack you. Also, if you start sleeping or begin the exorcism ritual, the monsters will be immediately destroyed to prevent any interruption.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468522/07eb5410a238c44a95387ad9a481fff494170c9b.png

Bug Fixes 🪲:

 Fixed morgue interior shine bug.
 Excessively bright church interior lights have been adjusted for a more atmospheric effect.


Optimizations⚙️:

 Game size has been reduced from 6.65GB to 2.85GB.
 Memory usage has been reduced to make the game smoother and help prevent crashes.
 Some screen effects have been optimized to improve FPS.


Whats next:

 We will fix the crematorium double-burning and timer bug.
 We will add a feature to close the graves of escaped deceased.
 We will make tombstone placement more flexible.

And more…

To reach out to us or share your feedback and suggestions, please use our Discord server or Community Group.

Our Discord Server: https://discord.gg/bsQFhKWyww
Community Group: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2925970/discussions/

notes.title: Update: Bug Fixes, Changes & What's Next
notes.content:
Hello there!

This update includes some changes and bug fixes:

🔨 Changes:

 The undead will no longer escape randomly. They will now only rise from their graves once the grave comfort drops below 30%.
 Groundskeeper's grave requirement has been reduced from 50 to 35.
 Added more detailed cleanup information to the Grave Detail window.


🪲 Bug Fixes:

 After loading a saved game, casket parts will no longer appear above ground.
 The undead that rises from its grave during the tutorial will no longer escape into the forest until the tutorial is completed.
 Performance improvements for players with a large number of graves in the game.


✨ What is next:
The Cursed Hours: During certain hours, the map will be shrouded in thick fog, and demonic entities will attempt to attack you. (However, if you're asleep during this time, the curse will pass without incident.)

notes.title: Update: Tombstone Cleaning & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello there!
With this update, we fixed some critical bugs and gameplay issues, made optimization improvements, and added new features.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed the groundskeeper getting stuck.
 Fixed the dirt pile interaction issue.
 Resolved the price mismatch between the negotiation price and the initial price.


Optimization:

 The low-quality setting has been optimized for low-end systems.
 A shadow toggle option has been added to the Quality Settings menu for low-end systems.


New Feature: Tombstone Dirt Cleaning
Tombstones will get dirty over time, and you can clean them using a Watering Can.
If you have hired the groundskeeper, he will take care of it for you.

notes.title: Update: Ash System & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello there!
Our very first game update is now live!

New Features:

-Ash Urn: After the next cremation process is completed, the ashes of the deceased will appear on the crematorium drawer. You’ll be able to place them into an urn and deliver it to the deceased’s relative.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468522/19dd844c57cd09fe5e01bffa48fb9d87dbb04473.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468522/070d3992d3beee0e9c1b4e921099ec7a4c914802.jpg

Bug Fixes:

-Fixed the issue where graves placed side by side couldn’t be dug properly.

-Fixed a rare bug where the watering can would sometimes cause an error.

What’s coming in the next update:

-Gravestones will gradually get dirty over time and will be cleanable

-Optimization improvements

-A new “Graphics Quality” setting for low-end systems

-And more...
